def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    bg=max(set(x for r in grid for x in r),key=lambda x:sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    pts=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg and sum(row.count(grid[r][c]) for row in grid)==1]
    if not pts: return g
    r,c,col=pts[0]
    for i in range(h):
        if g[i][c]==bg: g[i][c]=col
    g[r][c]=4
    for br in (0,h-1):
        vs=[j for j in range(w) if grid[br][j]!=bg]
        if vs and ((br==0 and r>h//2) or (br==h-1 and r<h//2)):
            cc=(min(vs)+max(vs))//2
            for i in range(h):
                if g[i][cc]==bg: g[i][cc]=col
    return g
